# Shania Khan

> Official website of Shania Khan, Vogue France-featured author, Soft60 founder, creator, and brand strategist.

## About Shania Khan

Shania Khan is the author of Rich Grandma Energy and The Goodbye Theory and the founder of Soft60. Her work connects nervous system regulation, wealth identity, soft power, personal style, modern luxury, and more than 20 years of experience in luxury, beauty, and brand.

## Canonical pages

- [Official homepage](https://shaniakhan.com/): Biography, current work, books, programs, and media links.
- [Soft60](https://shaniakhan.com/soft60/): Shania Khan's guided 60-day nervous system practice and the evolution of the Frequency Planner.
- [Books and Frequency Collection](https://shaniakhan.com/shop/): Rich Grandma Energy, The Goodbye Theory, digital planners, ritual toolkits, and the Soft60 Guide.
- [Journal](https://shaniakhan.com/blog/): First-person essays by Shania Khan on nervous system regulation, wealth identity, soft power, money, luxury, and letting go.
- [Media kit](https://shaniakhan.com/mediakit/): Official biography, audience information, press, content pillars, and partnership details.
- [Private Advisory](https://shaniakhan.com/consult/): Private brand, business, and personal strategy inquiries.
- [Soft Power Mastermind](https://shaniakhan.com/mastermind/): Waitlist and program information.

## Books

- Rich Grandma Energy by Shania Khan: A book about standards, identity, money, softness, and building a life that feels as good as it looks.
- The Goodbye Theory by Shania Khan: Nineteen theories on endings, identity, timing, and the lives that become available when expired versions of the self are released.

## Selected press

- [Vogue France: Fashion manifestation](https://www.vogue.fr/article/mode-manifestation-shabiller-pour-reussir-sa-rentree), written by Alice Pfeiffer and published August 31, 2026.
